_decisions_2026_08_09: Gītā mūla entries are multi-verse SLABS (one entry = up to 4,262 chars / ~30 verses) and were emitting a single 1,541-syllable pāda that no TTS call could render. mula_verses=True splits them on the printed ॥ a/v ॥, which also supplies the ref the columns lack (verse/adhyaya are NULL).
Gītā mūla units are typed padya, NOT sutra: the sutra type splices the pranava exemplar around a unit, which is a BSB convention and would put a ॐ around every Gītā verse.
Gītā mūla metre is DETECTED (mula_meter=detect), not forced to SUTRA_METER: the Gītā is not uniformly anuṣṭubh (ch. 11/15 carry triṣṭubh-class metres).
No ref is fabricated where none is printed: Madhva comments on a SELECTION of verses, so positional numbering would invent wrong Gītā references. Those blocks key on source seq.

Undetected quotations fall back to the NEAREST-LENGTH bank reference, not a fixed metre (89% of bhagavata_tatparya's were 16-syllable anuṣṭubh hemistichs). Shipped works keep the fixed fallback so they stay byte-identical.
Works run SERIALLY on all 8 cards (user call): QC and assembly are single-machine, so overlapping works would idle cards for less benefit than finishing one grantha cleanly.
box5 (.167) joined the pool: its NVML is broken (nvidia-smi fails, driver 560.35.03 vs lib .05) but CUDA works, so torch renders fine. box1->box5 needed an ed25519 key; the RSA one was rejected.

Pranava re-cut to 0.877 s by period-synchronous stretch of the 0.557 s exemplar's pitch-stable zone, and is now DISPLAYED as its own karaoke line. PREBUILT holds the sūtra BODY only so framing applies.

Bhagavata Tatparya mangala, 2nd hemistich: the model's learned visarga echo put a 0.6 s gap inside the line at 'समस्ताः सकलगुणनिधिः'. Diagnosed by sweeping seeds (pause present in all 10, only its length varied: 0.36-0.60 s), references (malini removed it), and sandhi forms. The fix is removing the WORD BOUNDARY (समस्ताःसकल…) at seed 62 — the letter change alone does not work (visarga->स् with the space kept still breaks), nor the seed alone. Approved by ear and PINNED via assemble_bsb.PREBUILT on the clip id, so the printed text keeps its space and only the audio uses the joined rendering. If the text ever changes the id changes and the pin stops applying.

Four supervisors (night_run, roll2, finish_works, finish_box1) proved worse than one: roll2 died silently and the others kept waiting for clips nothing was producing, so Gita Tatparya sat idle for an hour with 8 free cards. stage_next.py now owns the whole queue, judges progress by CLIPS ON DISK (not .done flags, which vanish when a node is restaged), and relaunches a work's shards once if progress stalls ~25 min. It ran 6 works unattended overnight with no intervention.

box3 (.180) down for the SECOND time, both times during sustained dual-GPU rendering; ARP INCOMPLETE from box1, so it is powered off, not flapping. Suspect PSU/thermal under ~750 W sustained. Cap with nvidia-smi -pl 200 or run one GPU before trusting it with a long job.

_decisions_2026_08_12: segment_anu parens bug: the editorial-parenthesis strip deleted characters from the stream AFTER load_stream recorded each entry's offset in it, so seqs_in mapped ślokas to entries by stale offsets. Now blanked to equal-length spaces. Audited every parens=True work: tantrasara/sadachara/krshna/sangraha all align 0-mismatched (too few parentheticals, or entries too long for the drift to cross one), so nothing already shipped is damaged.

build_shard_bsb with --shards>1 never wrote <stem>.json or <stem>_man.json, so QC died on rg_bhashya — the first work rendered from scratch since the omission appeared — and the supervisor assembled unverified audio. Builder now always writes both.

Five short works (yamaka_bharata, parishishta, yati_pranava_kalpa, jayanti_kalpa, nyasa_paddhati) registered as shape B, split=number; 346 clips rendered in ONE combined pass since five model loads would cost more than the synthesis. Yamaka hyphens (व्या-सोऽभवत्) are stripped in the shard only — the display keeps them, since the pun is the poem.

nyaya_vivarana.note: Shape A: each section is headed by the SŪTRA itself (content_type Title, framed ॐ…ॐ with the pūrvapakṣa/siddhānta pair), so it pairs like Sūtra Bhāṣya. comm=("Sarvamula","Mula") because the 15 Nyāyamālā verses quoted from Anuvyākhyāna are typed Mula. mula_prose=True: several Title entries hold MANY sūtras at once and a mūla is otherwise one pāda — max clip was 125 akṣaras (~30 s in one breath), now 61. 1,548 clips, staged 13 Aug 11:20.

_decisions_2026_08_13: Reader bug: renderWork drops a chapter's first row only when isHeading() says so, but isHeading omitted 'Title' and 'Skandha_Heading' even though CHAP_ORDER splits on them — so Nyāya Vivaraṇa printed each of its 215 sūtra headings twice, once as the chapter title and again as the opening row. Both types added.

segment_bsb load_blocks silently discarded any content type that was neither mūla nor commentary. comm may now be a tuple, and a guard prints what falls through with its akṣara count — Nyāya Vivaraṇa would have lost 2,331 akṣaras of Nyāyamālā verse without a word.

_decisions_2026_08_15: Recording pipeline (cut_recording.py): TS marks the TAP, not the voice — a retake’s mark lands ~1 s after the reciter resumes, so blocks opened mid-word. --snap anchors at the mark and walks to the pause bounding the utterance, both directions, bounded by neighbours. Reproduces every hand correction to within 40-54 ms. Applied to the Ṛgveda recordings only.
Energy cannot remove a trailing burp: one measured 0.151 RMS, the level of quiet recitation. That needs text-aware alignment (Su-shrota), still unbuilt.

normalize.js offset-transliterated U+0951-0954 into UNASSIGNED codepoints (U+0CD1/0CD2 in Kannada, U+0C51/0C52 in Telugu) — the Vedic accents could never render in any font. Now passed through unchanged. The font work layered on top of this was misdirected and reverted.
